text.body:
[p. 169] namaḥ śrīvajrasattvāya |
jayati sukharāja ekaḥ kāraṇarahitaḥ sadodito jagatām | yasya ca nigadanasamaye vacanadaridro babhūva sarvajñaḥ || 1 ||
guruvaracaraṇacirātiśayabhaktyādeśaviśeṣaḥ | svasmṛtaye likhito 'tra mayā ko budhajanavidveṣaḥ || 2 ||
asminn advaye prakṛtipariśuddhe sahajāvasthayaivātmanaivātmāmaṇ puṃstrīrūpam abhinirmāya tadarthapratipattaye svakam eva rūpaṃ svarūpeṣu sṛṣṭvā vyaktabhāvānugatatattvam iha darśayati – sahajavinirmitaramyarāmāvalokanataḥ suratasukhecchāmānaso bhagavān atiśayasarāgasalīlāvalokitānāṃ tato mṛdutarapeśalahṛdayagrāhisubhāṣitānāṃ tatas tadanugatasurabhighanavilepanabahalaparimalāhṛtahṛdayavivṛtīnāṃ tato gṛhītahṛdayaḥ san amṛtaghaṭaśatābhiṣekaprīṇanamahāsukhasaṃprāpta iva sarabhasamāliṅganasukhaprakārāṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtārtham ivātmānaṃ manyamāno 'nupamarasam āsvādayann iva hṛdyacumbanaprakārāṇāṃ tato 'pi daśanacchedyabhedyādiviśeṣāṇāṃ tadanu gati[p. 170](ta)suratasukhaikajātim apanudan mṛdutarāntaranakhanipātanacodanabodhanānāṃ tato 'pi bahuvidhaghanakuṭilakalakaṇṭhakūjanavinodādīnāṃ svabhāvaiḥ pañcākārasvapnopamaṃ svanāṭakaṃ svayam evodvahati | etena taccittaviśeṣalabdhighaṭanapracārānucaryāpravṛttiḥ kṛtā bhavatīti |
priyasnigdhālokais tadanu ca madhusyandivacanaiḥ tataḥ premāsārair atha [ca] rasarājair upanataiḥ | na jāne taccheṣakramaratarasā kāsmi sa ca kaḥ kim apy anyat saukhyaṃ sakhi na vacasāṃ gamyam uditam || 3 ||
sāgrahacaryāpravṛttir anayā cobhayor amanobhavodbhavaprasaraprabandhanād baddhobhayacittavṛttī bhavataḥ yena yāvad dve api cittavṛttī ananyasmṛtir iti sukhaikapravṛttivartamānotsavotsukitasnehatarataralasalilamīlananirapekṣanirantare bhavataḥ | tatas tadanantaraṃ ca balād ivāntaścittavṛttir vartamānotsāhād acintitakaraṇacāturyaprakārair bahusītkārair ubhayoḥ sarvanirapekṣamahāsamarasaratabharaghaṭanasaṃvardhanam abhavat | ato 'py atyantābhyāsasukhakriyāvibodhitopabhogagahanasurata[p. 171]sukhasaṃvardhanajanitātīndriyasvapratipattigocaraḥ saṃsārasārasukharāśijāto 'bhūd iti |
yad idaṃ sanimittasukhaṃ tad eva jagatāṃ nimittaparihīṇaṃ jñānaṃ svayambhūrūpaṃ mahāsukhaṃ kalpanāśūnyaṃ vāsanātattvodayacittam | etasmād yo māyopamādisvaviracitasaṃsārasūkṣmaprabandhavāsanāticañcalānavagrāhitirobhūtacittasantatipravṛttisukhaskhaladavasthākālānukalitābāhyavinihitasakalakalpanāpaṭalapaṭojjvalaḥ sukhātmā śuddhasattvasvabhāvo jagatprabhuḥ savāyur asau retobindubhiḥ sārdhaṃ pariprāptartuyoṣito nābher adho 'dhomukhāṣṭadalāgrasavikāsikamalodaragalitaśeṣaśoṇitam āliṅgati | tadanantaraṃ ca tatra kamalam anumukulitam utpadyate | tatra ca dve api raktaretasī ārambhake nijaprakṛtike kṣīrasalilam iva miśrībhūya piṇḍākāratvam abhavat | tac ca kalalādito 'tivalanaparipāṭigatānukramajātasakalabhūtasaṃcayopacayaṃ labhate | yatra ca pṛthivyādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ samavāyas tatra sā vedanā vyaktabhāvam anudarśayatīti pañcaskandhavad vedanātmakaṃ śarīram abhavat | asāv anuvedanātiniyatapratyā[p. 172]sattyaiva sarvavyāpi sarvagato 'ticapalamahābhūtamānasasaṃniyuktasvaprādeśikī satī bāhyapañcendriyagrāmamantrigamyamānā kalpitabahirgatarūpādigrāhyagrāhakabhāvābhibhūyamānā mohātmano 'sūyāmātsaryabhayaśokerṣyāghṛṇādayātṛṣṇeṣṭāniṣṭādikair ghasmarataraṃ saṃsāracakram anuvāhinī bhavatīti |
pūrvajanmakṛtahetukarmataś cittam etad iha janmasaṃgraham | yāti nūnam akhilaṃ karandhayaṃ sarvam eva kurute savāsanam || 4 ||
|| iti saṃsāravyavasthā ||
etasya ghorataradustarasaṃsārajalanidhigatāhaṃkāraduravagāhasalilaparamparāparasparopakarṣaṇakharataraviṣamapavanāvartavistarataraṅgonmajjananimajjanaparasparaghanasantare taraṇataritaraṇḍakaṃ kṛpāmayaparamavatsalasvabhāvaṃ mahākāruṇikam udāraṃ ca praṇidhivaragurucaraṇāravindayugalaṃ niḥśreyase ye ca saṃsāriṇaḥ paramayā bhaktyā na praṇamanti na saṃstuvanti na bhajante na saṃtoṣam utpādayanti na teṣāṃ dustarāpadvāridher uttaraṇaṃ parikalpyate | tasmāt sarvathā sarvadā sadgurucaraṇāravindayugalaṃ niḥśreyase naiḥśreyasam upāsanīyam iti |
asmād ghoratarād anantaviṣayād durvāramārārṇavāt saṃsārād yadi no bhavanti guravaḥ potopamās tāyinaḥ | [p. 173] tat kasmāt svavikalpajālabahulād vyālākulād vyākulāḥ prāpsyanty atra paraṃ sukhaikanilayaṃ buddhatvam ete janāḥ || 5 ||
|| sadguruparyupāsanam ||
asya ca paritoṣādeśād yo hi capalatarānavabuddhya samastendriyagrāmābhibhūyamāno 'nupamaviṣayasukhasaṃvardhanavyagrograś citrakara iva svaviracitacaṇḍaikataracitram avalokya svayam eva bhayād ativiṣaṇṇaḥ kātaratām upagacchati tadvad atrāpy abhūtasaṃkalpaghaṭanāpaṭalaṃ parikalpya svayam eveṣṭāniṣṭādikalitakarmakṛtavāsanābhibhūto vivaśaḥ svakīyaṃ rūpam abhyaset |
anādisaṃsāracakraṃ cakram ivodvahan viśve 'dharībhūte 'sau bhūtastho vijñānasvabhāvo 'yam iha prāṇas tiṣṭhatīti | sa cendriyebhyo 'pakṛṣyānavaratasvapraveśanirgamanijavartmavyāpāre vyavasthāpyate | etena cānekavitathasakalakalpanājālālavālabahalalolupasamalasalilasaṃghātasekasaṃvardhanātidūroparūḍhabhavabhūruhagatapariṇatayanānandajananaśravaṇasukhakṛdatisurabhisurasabahuvidhasthūlaphalānubhavanaghanajātataruṇatṛṣṇāto vinivṛttaḥ syāt sa punaḥ sahajam evānusarati | tatrāvasthitaḥ san bahirgataṃ sarvam eva vijahāti | tatrāpi sahajavyāpāro 'stīti tam eva vyāsaṅgam anubhavan cañcalātmā vyavatiṣṭhate | tatrāpi viśeṣeṇopalabhamāno 'nubhūtavastunaḥ punaranubhavane 'nurāga eva na syād ity ataḥ pravṛttiśaithilyam āvahati | [p. 174]
kiṃ bahunā | yad evāyaṃ svarūpāvasthito bhūtas tadā bahirgataḥ kalpitarūpebhyo 'vyavacchinnaḥ san svabhāvāvasthito bhavati | tatrāpi nijastokaviṣayapravṛttigalitānurāgabhagnodyama ātmīya evālaye śayanonmukhaḥ syāt | tatra ca sakalaguṇavān ayaṃ bhavatīti sthairyam apy asya guṇaḥ syāt | ity ataḥ sthiratvaguṇagato bhavatīti | yathā nikhilagaganāṅgaṇavyāpigahanagarjanagambhīrajaladharapaṭalavilīyamāno na kvacit (na?) gatam avagamyate tathāyam api santānapavano viśrānta evāsīt sampratilīyamānaḥ paramanivṛttim āpannaḥ kvacid api na gacchet |
svasthānasthaḥ sahajapavanaḥ kalpanājālamuktaḥ svāntas toṣaṃ kam api janayaty eṣa śūnyasvabhāvaḥ | asmāt pūrvoditabahukṛpopāyahetor avaśyaṃ saṃsāre 'smin prabhavati sadānantasattvārthakalpaḥ || 6 ||
|| cetaḥsthirīkaraṇam ||
tathā ca śrūyatām – satyāṃ cañcalatāyām indriyābhigamanād indriyārthasaṃnikarṣaḥ, indriyārthasaṃnikarṣād vastūpalambhaḥ, vastūpalambhād iṣṭāniṣṭādibahutarāgrahagrastadustarasaṃsāraḥ, sthiratvāc ca tuṅgatām utpattiviśeṣaprapañcarahitāṃ bodhasvabhāvāṃ nijaprakṛtitarāṃ tejasvinīṃ buddhim anusmarati | yadā ca tayāliṅgito bhavati tadā gagane gaganam iva [p. 175] miśrībhūyotpattiviśeṣaviṣayaḥ prāk prītipramodavān nirvikalpo 'kalpakhasamaḥ sarvamudrādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhito 'nutpādavān atīndriyaḥ svapratipattigocaro 'vyapadeśyo 'nya eva prajñopāyasvabhāvaḥ sukhātmā nāyakacitto 'bhūt |
buddhyanusāriṇi pavane sasukharūpaḥ svacittakṛtatoṣaḥ | acalas tābhyām anyaḥ prajñopāyātmakaḥ ko 'pi || 7 ||
|| prajñopāyātmakasphuṭatattvacittasaṃsthānam ||
tāny api pūrvaparityaktendriyāṇi manovisaṃniyogā akāraṇatām upagatāni tyaktamātaro vatsā iva mātaram evānuvartante tadvad atrāpīndriyāṇi mano'nuvartamānāni yatra manas tatra pravartante | yatas tena vinaiṣāṃ prayoga eva nāstīti | sāmpratam ayaṃ tatra viśeṣaḥ – asmin prajñopāyotpannamahāsukhālokasthāne parityaktasakalakalpanākalāpaniratiśayabhogatām upagate karaṇagrāme 'nupraviṣṭe sati jagad idam eva mahāsukhākārarasaikatāṃ prayāti | yathā ca ravikarakadambāvabodhitaśaśibimbena pratibimbāyitaṃ pratirūpam iva jagad avabhāsate tathaivāgrahaśūnyaiḥ kāraṇagrāmaś cetasonmiśratayā sārdham asamasarasasukhasampadam anutpādaśriyā sakalam eva calācalaṃ viśvam eva mahāsukhākāraṃ syāt |
etenaiva tad uktaṃ (etad uktaṃ) bhavati – tais tirobhūtair indriyagrāmair amṛtakalpair anukūlavartibhiḥ sārdhaṃ jagati prabhutvam āpanno 'dhīśvaraḥ svāmī [p. 176] svātantryeṇaiva pravartate | tatrāgrahaśūnyāni tadaharjātabālasyevendriyāṇy api tadanucaracārubālaviracitacāturyam ivopadarśayanti tam upabhuñjante yatrāsau sarvasaṃkalpavarjito nāyakaḥ svabhāvaśuddho jñānākāras tatrāsau sotkarṣavyaktabhāvānugatakaraṇagrāmānupraviṣṭaḥ pravartate | ity evaṃvidhakavalitakaraṇagrāmaṃ yadi cittam eva na syāt kutas tarhi viśvam idam udgamyamānam udbhavati | na hi cetasaḥ parataḥ paramaḥ parasparam āsta iti |
viniviṣṭendriyavargo naṣṭavikalpo 'samāptabhavabījaḥ | ānandabhāsayāsau gaganasamo 'py ahaha śītalaḥ svāduḥ || 8 ||
|| viniviṣṭendriyagrāme prajñopāyanibandhi mahāsukhacittam ||
atha vā kim anena nānānādivāsanāsamūhātivāhitabālavyutpāditena cittam eva yadi vasturūpi na bhavati, kutas tarhi bāhyārthaḥ | atha cittam eva vasturūpi bhavati, tathāpi taccittam evāntar iti sarvathā bāhyārthotpattir eva nāstīti cittam evedaṃ kalpanāśūnyam utpattivināśarahitam advayam iha śuddhasvabhāvaṃ jñānākāraṃ parisphurati kṛtsnam | etenaitad uktaṃ bhavati – svabhāvaśuddhād bodhicittād ye khalv ete sahajavinirgatāṅgavikṣepāḥ te sarva eva mudrāprakārāḥ, ye 'pi ca vāgvikṣepās te mantraprakārāḥ, yad api ca sahajonmīlanaviṣpandanam anavaratam anavasthitam asaṃskṛtam aparimitaṃ nānākārarasabhāvaceṣṭāyitaṃ śṛṅgāravīrabībhatsaraudra[p. 177]hāsyabhayānakakaruṇādbhutaśāntādikam api ca rāgadveṣamohamadamānamātsaryerṣyādi yat kiṃcid utpadyate tat sarvaṃ śuddhasvabhāvajñānākāraṃ pratiphalati sakalam iti sarvaṃ traidhātukaṃ cittam ayam idam | tathā ca –
kvacit kāruṇyātmā kvacid api mahārākṣasamaḥ kvacin maunaṃ dhatte kvacid api ca maukharyam asamam | kvacit tṛṣṇālolaḥ kvacid api ca cintāmaṇisamaḥ kvacin nidrāsuptaḥ kvacid api ca jāgarti nibhṛtam || 9 ||
kvacit tuṣṭo miṣṭāt kvacid api jaratpūtidhṛtimān kvacid rāgāsaktaḥ kvacid api virāgaikanilayaḥ | kvacic chīlasthānaḥ kvacid ahaha daurjanyanilayaḥ kvacit sthairyārambhaḥ kvacid api taḍiccañcalagatiḥ || 10 ||
kvacil līlāraktaḥ kvacid api ca hāsyaikarasikaḥ kvacit svacchandātmā kvacid api tathā baddhagatikaḥ | kvacid viṣṭāsīnaḥ kvacid api pavitraḥ śucitanuḥ kvacid vyākhyādakṣaḥ kvacid api jaḍimnaikakaṭhinaḥ || 11 ||
kvacit stokāt tṛptaḥ kvacid api ca saṃtoṣavimukhaḥ kvacin nṛtyāveśaḥ ślathataramanovṛttiviṣayaḥ | kvacid gītotkarṣī kvacid api mahākrandanaparaḥ kvacit saukhyādhāraḥ kvacid api ca duḥkhaikavivaśaḥ || 12 ||
kvacid dyūtakrīḍāvyasananirataḥ kvāpy anugataḥ (uparataḥ) kvacid dhūlīmlānaḥ kvacid api sukhasnānasubhagaḥ | [p. 178] kvacid digvāsāḥ syāt kvacid api ca citrāṃśukavṛtaḥ kvacid dātā bhoktā kvacid api manodīnagatikaḥ || 13 ||
kvacin mithyāvādī kvacid api ca satyaikavacanaḥ kvacid dharmavyūhaḥ kvacid aghaghanotpādamahimā | kvacid darpādhmātaḥ kvacid atividheyo 'tisujanaḥ kvacin māyāvī saḥ kvacid api viśuddhoddhatasudhīḥ || 14 ||
kvacid draṣṭā dṛśyaḥ kvacid api ca na prāptamahimā kvacit pañcābhijñaḥ kvacid api na yātaḥ kṣayagatim | kvacid bhūtastho 'sau kvacid api ca bhūtātiśayitaḥ kvacin nānākāraḥ kvacid api ca vācām aviṣayaḥ || 15 ||
kvacid vyādhisthānaḥ kvacid api mahāsaukhyanilayaḥ kvacid bhikṣādakṣaḥ kvacid api mahārājamahimaḥ | kvacid yogānandaḥ kvacid api pṛthak prāṇisadṛśaḥ [missing] || 16 ||
itītthaṃ svacchandaṃ sahajagatikaṃ kalparahitaṃ nirālambaṃ bimbaṃ sthitam iti mano yasya kṛtinaḥ | karasthaṃ tasyaitat sugatapadavīprāptamahima mahārambhapremaprasṛtaparamaṃ satsukhapadam || 17 ||
|| ity anutpādādyānandaikarasacittam || [p. 179]
ata eva –
sarvabhāvasvabhāvāgraḥ sarvadharmasamāsamaḥ | sarvajñaḥ sarvavit sarvaḥ sarvadharmasvabhāvadhṛk || 18 ||
apratiṣṭhitanirvāṇo jagadarthakaraḥ samaḥ | ekānekasvabhāvastho niḥsvabhāvo 'calo mahā || 19 ||
pratyātmavedyo bhagavān upamāvarjitaḥ prabhuḥ | sarvagaḥ sarvavyāpī ca kartā hartā jagatpatiḥ | saḥ śrīmān vajrasattvo 'sau vyaktabhāvaprakāśakaḥ || 20 ||
(iti) śrī{}oḍiyānamahāvajrapīṭhasvayambhūjñānasaṃbhūtaśrīmadyoginīsārthasamyakkutūhalocchalitadharmatattvatathyasākathyādhiṣṭhānatribhuvanavajrasamādhisamadhiṣṭhitasamayasarabhasavikasitavadanakamalavigalitamadhumahāsukhasampadamṛtavarṣabhūridhārāśravantī vyaktabhāvānugatā tattvasiddhiḥ samāptā |
cittasya tathā vāsyāttadanujñātānumatamahārthasaṅgītiprastāvyatābhivaivarṇyaṃ śrutvā ṣā(?)bhiyuktajananayanapatham avatīryaṃ prakaṭitarūpiṇī vyavahṛtapūrvābhibhagavati(tī) cirataram anumatam anuditam iti |
yasya na bhūtagaṇair gaṇanāsti kevalam ātmaviśuddhadhiyaiva | etad ahāsapathiṣyati bhāvāt tasya ca satsukham | iti viviktā yoginininayamahārṇavanaukā satsukhapraṇayinī likhitā tattvasiddhiḥ ca mayā śubhasiddhyā siddhyā siddhir astu tisṛṇāṃ jagatīnām ||
|| samāptā tattvasiddhiḥ ||
pustakamantranītiśāstramahārahasyaṃ samāptam iti |
